newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Hicor sinks to year low on fall in earnings.
newsitem.headline: Hicor sinks to year low on fall in earnings.

text.p: Shares in South African retail holding firm Hicor Ltd fell to a new year low on Tuesday after the firm posted lower earnings per share for the 15 months ended March 31, dealers said.

By about 0845 GMT Hicor was down seven cents or 11.5 percent to 54 cents, making it the second biggest percentage loser on the Johannesburg bourse in early trade. Volumes were small with only 5,300 shares trading.
"Because it was a 15-month period I think the guys expected the results to be a bit higher," one dealer.
"Their results are weaker than expected and that's why the share is just drifting off here," the dealer added.
